blocks.text: Oaklands Condos and Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: Oaklands is the lower-rise residential pocket west of the Highgate node in Burnaby's Edmonds area, around Oakland Street and the Southoaks Crescent area.
The City's 2026 curbside collection calendar map shows Oakland Street and 16th Avenue in this part of south Burnaby, next to the Deer Lake and Kingsway labels on the zone map.
The governing plan is the Edmonds Community Plan, officially adopted in March 2025 for the Edmonds neighbourhood in southeast Burnaby.
The area is in School District 41's Kingsway South zone, with Byrne Creek Community Secondary as the zone secondary school.

blocks.text: Oaklands Condos and Townhomes: the housing stock

items.t: The stock contrast with Highgate is the point here: away from the Kingsway and Edmonds node, the Edmonds plan document records existing forms ranging from 2 to 3 storey dwellings and townhouses upward, rather than a tower cluster.
The plan's Northwest Edmonds section, the district adjoining this pocket toward Metrotown, supports low and mid-rise forms along Kingsway with shorter low-rise forms beyond Kingsway.
Byrne Creek Community Secondary at 7777 18th Street is the secondary school the Province lists for this district zone.

blocks.text: Oaklands Condos and Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: The Edmonds Community Plan, adopted March 2025, sets the long-term height expectation here, with the tallest forms concentrated at the Town Centre, Station and Southgate nodes rather than in the low-rise pockets.
Existing parks in the adjoining Northwest Edmonds district, Burnaby South Memorial Park and Rene Memorial Park, are stated in the plan to continue serving as key green spaces.

blocks.text: Oaklands Condos and Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Collection day here is zone-based, and the City's 2026 curbside calendar uses colour zones, with Oakland Street shown on the south Burnaby part of the zone map.
The calendar system collects garbage every other week, while green bin and recycling are collected weekly.
The Burnaby Eco-Centre at 4855 Still Creek Drive is open 7 days a week, Monday to Sunday 8 a.m. to 4 p.m., for extra recyclables and yard trimmings drop-off.

blocks.text: Oaklands Condos and Townhomes: costs and taxes

items.t: The City's 2025 financial plan gives the utility pattern a buyer can check against a strata's budget: water fees of $620 and garbage fees of $139 for a 180-litre cart in the 2025 average single-family example, billed with the February utility bill.

blocks.text: Oaklands Condos and Townhomes: getting around

items.t: Edmonds Station on the Expo Line is the rapid-transit station for this area, listed by TransLink between Royal Oak and 22nd Street stations.

Kingsway is the corridor linking this pocket toward Royal Oak and Metrotown in one direction and the Edmonds Town Centre node in the other, as the plan's Northwest Edmonds section describes the adjoining district.
Collier Street between Salisbury Avenue and Hall Avenue, in the adjoining district, may be enhanced in future as a pedestrian and cyclist green corridor, per the plan material read.

blocks.text: Oaklands Condos and Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Start with the streamside check for any lot near a ravine edge: Burnaby's guide applies within 30 metres of a stream or freshwater wetland or shoreline, with leave areas set site by site.
The City's Environmental Review Committee page explains how a setback relaxation application is reviewed and what the application fee is.

Byrne Creek, which drains the south slope of Burnaby through a ravine park to the Fraser River, is the named watercourse system for this side of Edmonds; a buyer should confirm whether a specific lot drains to or borders it.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Oaklands?
faq.a: 9, in the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® month-end figures for October 2026. Listings change every day; Jared can tell you what is available now.

faq.q: Is Oaklands a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Oaklands had a sales ratio of 11% on only 9 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Oaklands from June to October 2026?
faq.a: Between June and October 2026, 8 condos and townhomes sold in Oaklands; Burnaby as a whole recorded 916.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: Which SkyTrain station should an Oaklands buyer plan around?
faq.a: Edmonds Station on the Expo Line is the named station for this area.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Oaklands sell for?
faq.a: 7 townhomes sold in Oaklands from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, at a median price of $1,390,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Oaklands?
faq.a: The median was 27 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 94.9% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
